sw_datapad_text: A katarn kit of Kashyyyk. The tiny hooks on its feet let it climb straight up the wroshyr trees. It stays calm in a crisis.
A young katarn. The leaf blades on its arms can slice through thick vines. It leaps from branch to branch in the canopy.
The apex hunter of Kashyyyk's wroshyr forests. The seeds on its back hold life for the trees. It guards the forest fiercely.
A desert chick of Tatooine. It holds the heat of the twin suns in its belly. Hugging it feels like hugging a warm stone.
A long-legged desert runner. It outpaces sandcrawlers across the dunes and kicks ten times a second when it fights.
A fiery desert fighter of the Dune Sea. Flames burst from its wrists when it fights. It can leap over a moisture tower.
A marsh amphibian of Naboo. The fin on its head senses the flow of the water. It can lift boulders far heavier than itself.
A marsh runner of Naboo's swamps. Its legs are strong in the deep mud. It is fast both on land and in the water.
A huge marsh titan of Naboo. It can sense storms coming by the waves. It pulls boats to shore with its great arms.
Tuskens keep massiffs to guard their camps. It snaps at anything that moves and will chase a speeder across the dunes until it tires.
The alpha of a massiff pack. Its bony spines rise when it is angry. Packs led by one will circle a moisture farm for days.
A striped desert scurrier of Tatooine. It zigzags across the sand and digs up lost scrap and coins for its trainer.
A fast desert runner. It dashes in a straight line at blazing speed to catch prey. It struggles to turn corners.
It burrows under the sand by day and sips dew at night. The spikes on its tail ward off womp rats. It splits into two cocoon lines.
A sandgrub wraps itself in silk spun from desert dew. It stays still inside and waits for the twin suns to warm it into a moth.
It flutters around moisture vaporators to drink the droplets on their vanes. Farmers on Tatooine say a sandmoth means water is near.
This sandgrub cocoon drips a bitter poison. It keeps its eyes open through the silk and remembers anything that harms it.
It flies only at night. When it beats its wings, a toxic dust falls that makes crops wilt. It is drawn to the lights of settlements.
A small bogling of Bogano. The lily pad on its back has grown too heavy for it to stay on land. It drifts on ponds and pools.
A reed creature of the Naboo marshes. It loves to play pranks on fishers, tugging at their lines from under the water.
A huge amphibian of Naboo's swamps. Gungans strap shield generators to its back. When it hears music, it sways and stamps its feet.
An acorn-shaped creature of Endor. It hangs from branches by its head and sucks up water. It looks just like a seed.
A trickster of Endor's forest. It plays the leaf on its head like a flute to unsettle travelers. It lives in hollow trees.
A forest lord of Endor. The fans on its arms whip up gales that can blow down a tree hut. It lives in the oldest trees.
A hawk-bat chick of Coruscant. It is small but fearless and will take on much bigger foes. It nests under the city's sky bridges.
A hawk-bat of Coruscant. It dives between the towers at high speed to snatch prey. It keeps its wings glossy and flies high on clear days.
A shyyyo chick of Kashyyyk. It rides the sea winds with its long wings stretched out. It nests on the cliffs along the coast.
A great shyyyo bird of Kashyyyk. It skims the sea and carries prey in its huge bill. Wookiees say it once carried a lost Jedi to safety.
A small Force-sensitive swamp sprite of Dagobah. It senses feelings with the horns on its head. It hides from anger.
A Force sprite that dances when its trainer is happy. Its dance bends the space around it. It shines in moonlight.
A Force sprite that will shield its trainer at any cost. It can see the future, and it guards its trainer from harm.
It skates across the still pools of Dagobah. A sweet scent from its head lures prey, and it flees if the water ripples.
Its wings carry eye patterns that frighten predators. It hangs from the gnarltree branches of Dagobah and flies off in the rain.
A fungal sprout of Felucia's jungles. It scatters spores when it is threatened. It lives in the damp soil under giant fungi.
A spore-capped fighter of Felucia. It throws punches with stretchy arms. The spores on its head make foes drowsy.
A lazy swamp sloth of Nal Hutta. It lies still all day and eats the leaves that grow within reach. It barely moves.
A restless swamp sloth that cannot sit still. Its heart beats ten times faster than normal. It must always be moving.
A giant swamp sloth of Nal Hutta. It lies down all day and eats the grass around it. When the grass is gone, it moves.
A small mist creature of Dathomir. It sleeps 18 hours a day. When it senses danger, it vanishes into the fog.
A mist creature that weaves fog with the Force. It carries a silver spoon that boosts its powers. It hides in the fog.
A wise mist creature of Dathomir. Its brain keeps growing, and it remembers everything. It holds a spoon in each hand.
A hive grub of Geonosis. It lives underground for years, sucking sap from roots. It cannot see well, so it feels its way.
A winged hive dart of Geonosis. It flies so fast it seems to vanish. Its buzzing wings give some people headaches.
An empty Geonosian shell, moved by a brain worm. It makes no sound and does not breathe. Peering into its back is said to steal your soul.
A small monkey-lizard. It cackles when startled, and once it starts it cannot stop. It hides in the rafters of cantinas.
A grown monkey-lizard. Its laugh is so loud it can shake walls. It stamps its feet to warm up before a cackling fit.
Its cackle can be heard for kilometers across the desert. The blast of sound from its open mouth can knock a speeder off course.
A mogu cub of Kashyyyk. It loves to wrestle and builds its strength by slamming into wroshyr trees.
A massive mogu of Kashyyyk. Its palm strikes can fell a tree. It roars and beats the ground before every fight.
It swims the rivers of Naboo, its tail fin waving like a gown. Its horn is sharp enough to pierce a Gungan bongo hull.
In autumn it swims upstream to lay eggs. Its body turns a bright color and it fights off rivals with its horn.
It is weak and only splashes about. Colo claw fry are found in every waterway of Naboo. Nobody knows how it survives.
The most savage predator of Naboo's planet core. Once it starts a rampage, it does not stop until everything around it is wrecked.
A bouncy rodent kit of the Naboo swamps. Its big tail is full of nutrients. It bounces on the tail to get around.
It floats in water on its round tail. Its fur repels water, so it stays dry even after a dive in the lake.
Its long ears can hear the movement of fish deep in a lake. It makes bubble rafts so its young can rest on the water.
A living rock found in the canyons of Tatooine. It lies still and is often mistaken for a stone, until someone steps on it.
It rolls down canyon slopes to get around. It eats rocks and grows larger. Moisture farmers find them blocking their roads.
A rolling mountain of a rock wart. It sheds its shell once a year. The cast-off shells crumble into the sand.
A magnetic stone of Kashyyyk's coasts. Its nose always points toward the galactic core, so lost spacers follow it home.
A playful loth-cat kitten. It chases its own tail until it gets dizzy. Lothal farmers let them roam to keep pests away.
An elegant loth-cat. It never lets its fur get untidy. It keeps no home and sleeps wherever it likes on the Lothal plains.
A silicon-based parasite. It clings to starship hulls and chews through power cables. Pilots check for them before every jump.
Its mouth opens wide enough to drain a power cell in seconds. It flies through asteroid caves in swarms.
A four-winged mynock of deep space. It flies so quietly that it can latch onto a ship's hull without the crew noticing.
A young dianoga. It drifts in sewers and seas with one eye on a stalk. It stings anything that brushes its tentacles.
A tentacled predator of sewers, seas and garbage pits. It can change color to match its surroundings. Never wade where it lives.
It lives deep in the caves of Ilum and eats crystals. Its eyes are raw kyber that glow in the dark. It hides from light.
A Separatist buzz droid. It hides its cutting jaws and looks harmless, then latches on and saws through starfighter armor.
A dwarf spider droid left over from the Battle of Kashyyyk. It eats scrap metal and burrows into the roots of wroshyr trees.
A three-eyed combat droid. It guards a patch of forest and marches over any intruder. Its tripod legs never tire.
An NR-N99 tank droid. It claims a whole mountain as its own and drives off anything that comes near. It repairs itself.
A B1 battle droid. It is weak alone, but it trains hard and never stops. It answers every order with a cheerful "Roger roger".
A B2 super battle droid. Its heavy frame lets it lift loads that would crush a B1. It is often mistaken for a heavy lifter.
A BX commando droid. It moves with four arms of strength. It can punch through durasteel and is never seen at rest.
A meditating monkey of Ilum's crystal caves. It sits still for hours to sharpen its focus. It eats one berry a day.
A crystal-cave ape of Ilum. Years of meditation give it a sixth sense. Its fighting moves flow like a dance.
A kath hound pup. Static builds up in its fur as it runs across the Dantooine plains. Its sparks keep predators away.
A kath hound whose mane crackles with lightning. It gathers static from the air. Thunderclouds form where it runs.
A podrace pit droid. It cheers its partner on with sparks and pom-poms. It folds up when tapped on the nose.
A GNK power droid. It shares its charge with droids around it and says nothing but "gonk". It is happiest beside a pit droid.
An MSE mouse droid. It scurries along the halls of starships and stations, beeping. It gets lost if its magnets are scrambled.
Three mouse droids linked into one unit. They send out strong magnetic waves that jam scanners and comlinks nearby.
A Jedi training remote gone feral. It floats and fires stinging bolts at anything that moves. It hides in empty temples.
An overcharged combat remote. It stores so much power that it may explode at the slightest shock. Handle with care.
A male firefly of the desert. At night it signals with its glowing tail, drawing the swarm together in shapes in the sky.
A female firefly that leads the swarm with a sweet scent. Glowflies follow her and draw patterns in the night sky.
A walking root bulb of Endor. By day it buries itself in the mud. At night it walks and scatters seeds.
A drooling root creature. The smell from its leaves is so foul that only one in a thousand can stand it. It loves the stink.
A giant toxic swamp flower of Endor. Its petals are the largest in the galaxy. Each step scatters allergic pollen.
A meadow flower of Naboo. When the sun shines, its petals spread and it dances. Its dances are said to call the sun.
A fast two-legged swamp runner. Gungans ride kaadu into battle. It cannot fly, but it runs faster than a speeder over mud.
A three-crested kaadu herd leader. Its three heads each feel a different mood. It leads the herd through the swamps.
A Felucian thorn flower. It blooms with poison flowers of two colors. The aroma it gives off soothes those who smell it.
A young sarlacc. It is almost all stomach and can swallow anything. It sleeps in sand pits after a big meal.
A sarlacc: a mouth, a stomach and a thousand years of digestion. It waits in the sand of the Dune Sea. Do not fall in.
An opee sea killer fry, all teeth. It attacks in schools and can tear apart the hull of a Gungan bongo.
An opee sea killer. It snares its prey with a long sticky tongue. It speeds through Naboo's core by shooting water.
An aiwha calf. It fills itself with water and bounces on the waves of Kamino. It sprays water from its blowhole to say hello.
The gigantic aiwha of Kamino. It can fly as well as swim, flapping huge fins. Kaminoans ride them across the endless sea.
A bantha calf. It never notices the heat of the twin suns. Its thick fur stores fat, so it can go weeks without water.
A huge, shaggy bantha, mount of the Tuskens. When it is angry, it stamps so hard the ground shakes like a quake.
A molten grub that crawls out of Mustafar's lava rivers. If it stops moving, it cools and hardens, so it never rests.
A giant shelled lava flea. Mustafarians ride them across the lava fields. Its shell is cooled lava and very brittle.
A coal-burning smelter droid. It burns coal in its belly for power. When it is hurt, thick black smoke pours from its vents.
A sludge creature from Coruscant's lowest levels. It formed from waste that dripped down from the upper city.
A toxic heap of living industrial waste. Plants stop growing where it crawls. A drop of its body can poison a pool.
A floating gas-bag calf from Bespin. Its body is full of tibanna gas. It floats along the cloud layers, puffing.
A giant Bespin gas-bag that breathes tibanna. Two beldons drift together and share gas. Cloud City mines what they leave.
A puffer pig that bounces on its spring-like tail. Its heart beats with every bounce. It sniffs out gems and ore in the tunnels.
A grown puffer pig. It wears the gems it found on its head. It puffs up and dances to bend the will of its foes.
A dewback hatchling. It rolls up into a ball in the sand to protect itself from predators and the twin suns.
A spiny desert dewback. Sandtroopers ride them on patrol. It curls up to defend itself, its spines facing out.
A dizzy spotted cub that never walks straight. No two have the same spots. Its wobble confuses its foes.
A vulture droid starfighter gone wild. It repairs itself with scrap. It makes nests from sharp metal in the mountains.
A krayt hatchling. It digs a cone-shaped pit in the sand and waits at the bottom for prey to slide in. It can go a week without water.
A young winged krayt. It rubs its wings together to make a whine that gives others headaches. It is still learning to fly.
A krayt dragon of the Dune Sea. It whips up sandstorms with its wings. Its roar echoes across Tatooine's canyons at dusk.
A spiny funnel flower of the desert. It stores water in its body, so it can live for a month without rain. Its spines sting.
It stands still in the desert by day, looking like a dead plant. At night it follows travelers who wander too far from camp.
A fluffy cloud-flyer chick of Bespin. It cleans everything around it with its cotton wings. It rides the warm air of the gas layers.
A Bespin cloud predator. It glides through the gas layers, singing a beautiful song. Its voice carries for kilometers.
A clawed arena cat of Geonosis. It is the sworn enemy of the kouhun. Its claws can tear through armor, and its eyes see heat.
A venomous assassin centipede. It sharpens its tail stinger on rocks. It sneaks into homes through vents to strike.
A moon-shaped living kyber crystal found on Ilum. It glows brighter when the moons are full. It floats with the Force.
A sun-shaped living kyber crystal of Ilum. It draws power from starlight. It spins as it floats, giving off heat.
A whiskered mud fish of Dagobah. Its slimy body is hard to grasp. Its whiskers feel the slightest movement in the mud.
A giant whiskered swamp fish. It can sense quakes coming. When it thrashes, the whole swamp ripples for kilometers.
A small crab droid that scuttles through the mud of Utapau. It grips anything with its pincers and will not let go.
An LM-432 Muckraker crab droid. It loves to fight and will throw anything near it. It patrols muddy shores in packs.
A spinning shard of an ancient holocron. It moves by spinning on its point. It is found among the ruins of Jedha.
An ancient floating holocron that speaks with the voices of the dead. It is said to have been made by Jedi long ago.
A fossil sea-lily from when Tatooine had oceans. Revived from a fossil, it clings to rocks and catches prey with its fronds.
An ancient sea-lily titan. It digs its roots into rock and waits for prey. It lived in the warm seas of ancient Tatooine.
A fossil shrimp from Tatooine's ancient seas. It swam with eight wings and caught prey with its claws.
An armored ancient predator. It grew stronger as it adapted to life on land. Its claws could cut through anything.
A round, soft creature of Tatooine. Its body is bouncy and it rolls everywhere. It sings in a squeaky little voice.
A puffball that sings a lullaby. Anyone who hears it falls asleep. It inflates itself to sing even longer.
A soft diva of Tatooine's cantinas. Its fur is the softest in the galaxy. It puffs up and sings to calm a crowd.
A drab swamp fish nobody wants. It is shabby and sluggish, but it survives where few others can. Few know what it becomes.
A radiant sea serpent, said to be the most beautiful creature in the galaxy. The sight of it calms any angry heart.
A weather probe droid of Endor. It changes its shell to match the weather. Its sensors can predict storms days in advance.
A star-shaped coral creature of Kamino. At night its core glows. As long as its core is intact, it can regrow lost limbs.
A glowing coral with a kyber core. Its core shines in seven colors. Some say it sends signals to the stars.
A creature invisible to sight and even to the Force. Only its wavy stripe gives it away. The ORGANA SCOPE reveals it.
A wisp left behind by a strong feeling. It feeds on envy and grudges, and gathers at the eaves of houses at night.
A doll that was thrown away and came to life from resentment. It hunts for the child who abandoned it. Its zipper seals in curses.
A small dark-side wraith that drifts among the tombs of Jedha. It can pass through walls. Crying children are its prey.
A dark-side wraith with one burning eye. Its body is hollow and it absorbs anything nearby. It hypnotizes foes with its eye.
A gentle flying thranta of Endor. Fruit grows in a bunch around its neck. Ewok children love to share the fruit.
A living temple wind-chime of Jedha. It rides the winds and rings when it senses the Force. Its cry soothes the heart.
A white Force wolf of Lothal. It appears before a disaster to warn others. It is said to know the hidden paths of the Force.
A crystal fox of Crait. Its coat is made of glittering crystal bristles. When it is warm it shakes off red salt dust.
An ancient crystal vixen. It is said to live for a thousand years. Its crystal fur sings when it moves through the caves.
A tiny rodent of Felucia that stores static in its cheeks. It is not yet good at storing power and may zap itself.
A rodent that discharges ion bolts from its cheeks. A whole nest of them can knock out a speeder's systems.
A large ion rodent. It can discharge enough power to drop a starfighter's shields. It digs its tail into the ground to vent.
A headache-prone swamp duck of Naboo. When its headache gets bad, it uses strange powers. It never remembers using them.
A sleek swimming swamp drake. It swims faster than any Gungan. Its brow glows when it uses its mysterious powers.
An ysalamiri hatchling of Myrkr. It gathers in groups to sleep. When it is happy, it pushes against its friends.
A lizard that pushes back the Force. It never attacks first, but it turns any attack back on the attacker. Jedi avoid it.
A convor owlet of Lothal. It stares at things without moving. It hops because it cannot yet fly. It sees the future.
A Force-sensitive convor owl. It is said to see both the past and the future. It stands still all day staring at the sun.
A long-necked Naboo herd beast. Its tail has a small brain of its own. It bellows at night across the grass plains.
A mudhorn calf. It plays by spraying mud from its nose. It is strong enough to carry a grown person on its back.
An armored horned charger of Arvala. It charges with its head down and can knock over a sandcrawler. Its hide is thick.
A hive insect of Alderaan with crushing mandibles. Its colony shares one mind. It grips its prey and does not let go.
A single-horned fighting beetle of Felucia. It loves sweet sap. Its horn can lift a load a hundred times its weight.
A rancor pup of Dathomir. It charges in a straight line and smashes anything in its way. It is not very smart.
A rancor. Its hide is as hard as armor, and it can crush boulders. Ask Jabba's keeper Malakili. He wept over his.
A wampa cub. It hides in the snow of Hoth and only comes out at night. It loves to eat snow.
Hoth's ice-cave predator. It hangs its prey from the ceiling of its cave. Its white fur makes it hard to spot.
A round ice seal pup of Hoth. It rolls across the ice faster than it can walk. It claps its flippers when it is happy.
An ice seal that balances things on its nose. It sniffs out new things to balance. It lives in Hoth's frozen seas.
A huge tusked ice walrus of Hoth. Its tusks can break through glaciers. Its thick blubber keeps it warm in the snow.
A clam of Kamino that grows a krayt-pearl once in its life. The pearl is said to boost its psychic power.
A deep-sea eel with a lure tail. It lives in the dark depths of Kamino's sea. Its tail looks like a small fish.
A graceful pink deep-sea eel of Kamino. Its body is very beautiful. It sucks body fluid from prey with its thin mouth.
A living fossil fish of Kamino. It has not changed in a hundred million years. Its rocky scales let it live on the sea floor.
A branching coral creature of Kamino. Tipoca City stands on a reef of them. Its branches grow back if they break.
An abyssal fish with glowing lures on its antennae. It uses them to talk with friends by flashing lights.
A deep-sea lantern fish of Kamino. Its light can be seen from the surface. It blinds its prey with a sudden flash.
A heart-shaped reef fish of Kamino. Couples who see one are said to be together forever. It swims in warm currents.
A small sea-horse of Kamino that sprays ink. It anchors itself to coral with its tail. It shoots ink to escape.
A spiny sea-horse. Its spines are poisonous. It sleeps among coral, and the males raise the young.
A sea dragon born in Kamino's storms. It sleeps on the sea floor. When it wakes, it whips up great whirlpools.
A dactillion hatchling that dreams of flight. It jumps off cliffs to try to fly, and its rock-hard head protects it.
A dactillion in its armored molt. It does not move. Inside its shell, its cells are changing for flight.
A great flying dactillion of Utapau's sinkholes. Its dream came true. It flies around the sinkholes breathing fire.
An old R1-series astromech. Its magnetic arms let it float. It beeps out data to other droids by radio.
An R4-series astromech. Two R1 units joined their brains to form it. It can fly at high speed with its magnets.
An R2-series astromech, the smartest droid line. Four brains link to form a supercomputer that can fly a starfighter.
An ancient stone sentinel sealed behind Aurebesh glyphs. Its whole body is made of rock. Its cracks heal with new stones.
An ancient ice sentinel. Its body is made of ice from the ice age. Not even lava can melt it. It chills the air around it.
An ancient durasteel sentinel. Its body is harder than any metal, and it heals itself. It was sealed away long ago.
A light-side Force dragon named for Tython's bright moon. It can sense the feelings of others and change its form.
A dark-side Force dragon named for Tython's dark moon. It can show others the images it sees. It flies faster than a jet.
Titan of the seas, the greatest of the sando aqua monsters. It is said to have widened the seas of Naboo.
Titan of the land, the eldest greater krayt dragon. It is said to have raised Tatooine's mountains in its fights with SANDO.
Titan of the void, the space slug that lives in an asteroid field. It calms the other two titans when they clash.
A star-creature from the Journal of the Whills. It wakes once every thousand years and grants any wish written on its notes.
A star-born creature of Atollon. It shifts between many forms. Its crystal core fires lasers from its chest.
A lizard with a seed bulb on its back. The seed was planted there at birth. It grows by taking in the sun of Kashyyyk.
The bulb on its back opens into a bud as it grows. It must bask in Kashyyyk's sun to bear the weight of the bud.
A huge lizard carrying a wroshyr bloom. The scent of the bloom calms all who smell it. It roams the forest floor.
A lizard of Mustafar with a flame on its tail. The flame shows its mood. If the flame goes out, its life will end.
A hot-tempered fire lizard. It swipes with its sharp claws. It lives near the lava rivers and seeks out strong foes.
A fire dragon of the lava rivers. It breathes flame hot enough to melt durasteel. It never fights a weaker foe.
A Mon Cala turtle pup. It hides in its shell when in danger, then sprays water at the first chance to strike back.
A turtle with feathered ears. It is said to live ten thousand years. It swims fast by moving its ears and tail.
A turtle with proton-torpedo cannons on its shell. It can blast water hard enough to punch through bulkheads.
A green caterpillar of Endor. Its feet have suction cups that let it climb any tree. It gives off a stench when in danger.
A hard green chrysalis. Inside its shell, its body is soft and changing. It does not move, to save its strength.
A powder-winged moth of Endor. Its wings are covered in powder that repels water. It flies even in the forest rain.
A horned stinging larva. The sharp horn on its head is poisonous. It hides in the leaves of Endor's trees.
A venomous chrysalis. It hangs from branches, almost motionless. If disturbed, it will strike out with its poison barb.
A three-stinger wasp of Endor. It flies at high speed and strikes with the poison stingers on its legs and tail.
A porg chick of Ahch-To. It is gentle and prefers to avoid fights. It flaps sand into the eyes of anything that bothers it.
A wide-eyed porg of Ahch-To. It flies in large flocks over the sea cliffs. It has a keen sense of direction.
A majestic elder porg. Its feathers shine in the sun. It glides over the waves of Ahch-To and dives for fish.
A womp rat, about two meters long. Farm kids on Tatooine shoot them from their T-16s. It will chew on anything.
A huge womp rat with gnawing fangs. Its fangs never stop growing, so it gnaws on rocks and droids to keep them short.
A noisy desert hawk. It flaps its short wings hard to stay in the air. It chases bugs above the scrub all day.
A long-beaked desert condor. It can fly for a whole day without landing. It picks prey out of the sand with its beak.
A desert snake of Tatooine. It coils up in the shade of rocks. It eats the eggs of sandhawks and duneswifts.
A hooded desert cobra. The pattern on its hood frightens its foes. Its venom paralyzes prey.
A ronto calf. It is small but its hide is tough. It follows its herd through the streets of Mos Eisley.
A young ronto. It is gentle and shy. Jawas ride rontos to the market towns to sell their scrap.
A towering, gentle ronto pack beast. It can carry loads that would crush a dewback. It is easily startled by droids.
A reek calf of the arenas. Its horns are short, but it charges anything it sees as a threat.
A horned young reek. Its temper is short. It sharpens its horns on the arena walls.
A massive arena reek. Its tusks can toss a speeder. It turns red when it eats meat, so arena keepers feed it well.
A shy moon-dancing creature of Endor. On nights of the full moon, groups of them gather and dance in the forest.
A rare moon dancer. It is so shy that it is rarely seen. Its hearing is so good it can hear a leaf fall far away.
A fungus-backed grub of Felucia. The mushrooms on its back draw nutrients from its body. They grow as it does.
A grub controlled by the fungus on its back. The fungus has taken over and moves it to damp, dark places.
A fuzzy, compound-eyed gnat of Dagobah. Its big eyes work like radar. It is drawn to lights at night.
A poison-dusted swamp moth. Its wing dust is poisonous. Dark dust means poison and light dust means paralysis.
A tiny burrowing mole of Bespin's mining layers. It lives just under the ground and eats roots. It hates bright light.
Three burrowing moles that act as one. They dig through Bespin's rock at high speed, which can set off quakes.
A scruffy cat of Corellia that hoards credits. It loves shiny things and roams the spaceport at night for coins.
A sleek, vain tusk-cat. It is very proud and fussy. Its tusks are a status symbol among Corellian gangs.
A gundark young, already loose. It is light on its feet and quick to anger. Once angry, it will not calm down.
A four-armed gundark of Vanqor. It is angry all the time. It chases foes until it catches them.
A loyal armored akk dog pup of Haruun Kal. It is very brave and barks at anything that comes near its trainer.
A legendary armored akk dog. It runs as fast as the wind. Its armored hide was prized by the people of Haruun Kal.
A worrt tadpole. Its thin skin shows its spiral guts. It cannot walk well yet, so it stays near water.
A long-tongued worrt from the grounds of Jabba's palace. Its tongue can snatch a bug from three meters away.
A muscular fighting worrt. Its arms are strong enough to swim across any river. It loves to wrestle.
A snapping vine bud of Felucia. It plants its roots in damp soil at night. It snaps at insects with its little mouth.
A carnivorous pitcher plant. It spits acid that melts anything. It hangs from Felucian branches and waits.
A giant flytrap flower of Felucia. It lures prey with a sweet scent and then swallows them whole.
An eopie, Tatooine's sun-baked pack animal. It can carry heavy loads across the dunes. Anakin rode one as a boy.
A racing fathier of Cantonica. It runs so fast that its hooves throw sparks. It longs to run free.
A Dagobah swamp slug, slow and strangely wise. It dangles its tail in the water to fish. It is very forgetful.
A swamp slug wearing a shellfish on its tail. The shellfish feeds on its leftovers. Neither notices the other.
A swamp turkey of Naboo that carries a reed stick. It uses the stick to build nests. It will fight to protect it.
A thala-siren pup of Ahch-To. It loves to swim in freezing water. A horn on its head breaks through the ice.
A thala-siren of Ahch-To. It lounges on the rocks and swims gracefully in icy seas. Its green milk is said to be very good for you.
A spiny clam of Kamino. It swims backward by opening and closing its shell. It sticks out its tongue to tease.
A fortress-shelled clam of Kamino. Its shell is harder than durasteel. It fires spikes from its shell to fight back.

sw_datapad_text: A wisp of dark-side gas from Moraband. It can poison an animal with its gas in moments. It floats in old tombs.
A dark-side shade with floating hands. It hides in the dark and licks its foes to steal their life.
A grinning dark-side specter of Moraband. It hides in shadows and lowers the temperature around it.
A rock-eating duracrete slug of Coruscant. It digs through the city's foundations at high speed, eating as it goes.
A small floating interrogation droid. It puts people to sleep and reads their dreams. It hums when it is busy.

sw_datapad_text: An IT-O interrogator droid. It swings a pendulum light to put its target to sleep. Nobody likes to meet one.
A pincered shore crab of Kamino. It uses its claws to dig and defend itself. Lost claws grow back.
A crab with one huge claw. The claw is strong, but heavy. It waves the claw to signal others.
A cluster of wroshyr seeds that think as one. Even if one seed is lost, the others carry on. It lives on Kashyyyk.
A walking wroshyr sapling. Each head thinks on its own. When one head grows too heavy, it falls and takes root.
A lonely cub wearing a krayt skull. It cries for its lost mother. The skull it wears never comes off.
A bone-club warrior of the Krayt Graveyard. It has toughened up and grown wild. It throws its bone club like a boomerang.
A combat droid with springy legs. It kicks so fast that foes never see it. Its legs can stretch out long.
A combat droid built for boxing. Its punches can drill through concrete. It needs a three-minute rest after a fight.
A long-tongued lizard of Nal Hutta. Its tongue is twice as long as its body. Its saliva causes numbness.
An FX-6 medical assistant droid. It carries a store of bacta and shares it with the injured. It is very kind.
A tangle of tentacles from Twon Ketter. Do not let them loose. Its tentacles grab anything that moves near it.
A mother beast of Dantooine that carries its young in a pouch. It will fight to the end to protect its child.
A mime of Naboo that builds invisible walls. It is a skilled performer, and its walls stop any attack.
A scythe-limbed arena beast of Geonosis. It strikes so fast that its blades leave afterimages.
A snow-hunting narglatch of Orto Plutonia. It prowls the ice with silent paws. Its spines warn off any rival.
An IG-series assassin droid crackling with power. It feeds on electricity. Power outages follow it.
A lava-spitting beast of Mustafar. It lives in the lava rivers. It spits fireballs, and its body is always burning hot.
A bad-tempered orray bull of Geonosis. It whips itself with its tail before it charges. It never stops once it starts.
A gentle purrgil that carries travelers across space. It can jump through hyperspace on its own. It sings as it swims.
A shapeshifting blob of Zolan. It can change into any creature it sees. When it sleeps, it melts into a puddle.
A tooka cat of Coruscant that adapts to anything. Its genes change to suit where it lives, so it has many forms.

sw_datapad_text: A water-adapted tooka. Its cells are like water, so it melts away when it swims. It lives near clean water.
A static-charged tooka. Its fur stands up like needles when it is angry. It fires bolts of lightning from its fur.
A fire-adapted tooka. It stores heat in its fur, which can get very hot. It breathes fire when it is angry.
A 3PO-series protocol droid. It is fluent in over six million forms of communication. It worries a lot.
A spiral-shelled fossil from the ancient seas of Mon Cala. It swam by twisting its ten tentacles.
A tentacled spiral fossil. Its heavy shell made it slow, and it is thought to have died out because of it.
A dome-shelled fossil. It lived on the sea floor long ago. Its eyes glow in the dark under its shell.
A scythe-armed fossil predator. It swam fast and cut down its prey with its sharp scythes.
An ancient flying predator revived from amber. It flew in the skies of Tatooine and attacked with its fangs.
A huge water beast of Jakku. It eats huge meals, then sleeps. Kids climb on its belly. It only moves to drink and eat.
A legendary ice bird of Hoth. It appears to travelers lost in the snow. It freezes moisture in the air to make snow.
A legendary storm bird of Bespin. It lives in thunderclouds and controls lightning. It is said to appear in storms.
A legendary fire bird of Mustafar. Its flapping wings scatter embers. It is said to bring the spring.
A hatchling dragonsnake of Dagobah. It sheds its skin many times as it grows. It hides deep in the swamp waters.
A Dagobah dragonsnake. It lurks under the murky water and swallows whole anything that falls in. It nearly ate R2 once.
A loyal varactyl of Utapau. It climbs sheer cliff walls with ease. Obi-Wan's Boga was one, and she never let him down.
A Kaminoan clone experiment that escaped. It was made by splicing genes, and it has the most savage heart of all.
The first creature, born in the Wellspring of Life on Mortis. It is said to hold the genes of every living thing.
A leaf-collared fawn of Endor. The leaf on its head gives off a sweet scent. It loves to bask in the sun.
A fawn with a bud necklace. The scent from its buds lifts the spirits of all who smell it.
A flowered forest stag of Endor. The flower around its neck heals wounds. Ewoks follow it to find clean water.
A mole of Sullust with a flaming back. It is timid, but when angered the fire on its back blazes up.
A fire-backed burrower. Its fur is fireproof. It digs through the volcanic rock of Sullust and leaves hot tunnels.
A volcanic burrower. It hides behind a shimmering heat haze. Its blasts of fire can set off eruptions.
A swamp croc hatchling of Dagobah. Its jaws are so strong it can crush anything. Even its trainer must be careful.
A swamp crocodile. If its fangs fall out, new ones grow back. It never lets go once it bites.
A huge swamp crocodile of Dagobah. It opens its jaws wide to scare off foes. It swims fast despite its size.
A meerkat of the desert that stands on its tail to look around. It sounds a cry to warn others of danger.
A long burrowing ferret of Tatooine. It digs narrow tunnels under the sand where larger predators cannot follow.
A one-legged forest owl of Endor. It always stands on one leg. It keeps perfect time and hoots at the same hour each night.
A wise night owl of Endor. Its eyes can see in the dark. It turns its head all the way around without a sound.
A spotted ladybug of Naboo. It is very timid and huddles with others for comfort. It flies only in the morning.
A four-fisted ladybug. It flies at night, scattering glowing dust from its wings. Its spots glow in starlight.
A krykna spiderling of Lothal. It spins a web and waits for prey. It can wait for days without moving.
A giant krykna spider of Lothal. It spins its web from both ends. It lurks in caves and old ruins.
A moon-dancer baby of Endor. It is often seen on nights with shooting stars. It is said to ride the falling stars.
An egg-shelled creature of Alderaan said to bring luck. Its shell is filled with happiness. It shares it with kind people.
A winged luck creature. It flies only to people with kind hearts. It sprinkles them with a shining down.
A fluffy nerf lamb of Alderaan. Its fluffy wool stores static. Touching it gives a shock. Herders wear rubber gloves.
A nerf. Yes, like the herders. It stores so much static that its tail gives off sparks. Its wool sells for a fortune.
A nerf whose tail lights like a beacon. The light can be seen from space. Lost travelers once followed it home.
A creature that pretends to be a gnarltree. It is actually more like a rock. It hates water and flees from rain.
A crowned worrt. When it croaks, all worrts gather around it. It leads the croaking choir at the edge of Jabba's palace.
A cotton seed of Bespin riding the cloud winds. It grips the clouds with its feet so it does not drift away.
A cotton flower of Bespin floating on winds. It opens its flower when the air is warm and drifts on the breeze.
Cotton puffs drifting across Bespin. They ride the winds around Cloud City and scatter spores in the gas layers.
A Felucian monkey with a hand on its tail. Its tail is so skilled that its real hands have grown clumsy.
A seed that drinks the light of Tatooine's twin suns. It falls from the sky in the morning. It barely moves.
A flower that follows both suns. It turns its face to the suns and stores their energy. It is lively all day.
A big-eyed swamp dragonfly of Dagobah. It can see in every direction. It hovers in place over the water.
An oggdo tadpole of Bogano. On cold mornings it leaves the water and wanders the shore. It is coated in slime that keeps it from drying out.
An oggdo, the giant frog of Bogano's marshes. It never thinks too hard. It sits with its mouth open and lets prey swim right in.
A tooka that turned to the light side. It evolves by day. Its fur can sense the slightest shift in the air.
A tooka that turned to the dark side. It evolves by night. When angered, the rings on its fur glow red.
A rawka of Dathomir. Seeing one at night is said to bring bad luck. It flocks around the Nightsisters' old ruins and hoards shiny things.
A crowned swamp slug, a sage of Dagobah. The shellfish on its head gives it great wisdom. It ponders all day.
A screeching wisp of Moraband. It loves to frighten people. It feeds on their fear and grows stronger.
Living Aurebesh glyphs. Each form is a letter. They line up to spell out messages that no one has yet read.
A droideka in its rolled-up wheel form. It hangs from walls and rolls at anyone who comes near.
A droideka destroyer droid with its shields up. It stands still and fires at foes. Its shell is hard as durasteel.
A small burrowing worm of Tatooine. It digs into the sand tail-first. If spotted, it digs away at once.
A gliding scorpion of Geonosis. It glides without a sound and strikes with its stinger. It nests on cliffs.
A duracrete slug with a durasteel hide. Its body is harder than any metal. It lives deep under Coruscant.
An anooba pup of Tatooine. It looks scary, but it is playful. It bares its fangs to frighten small creatures.
An anooba, the bulldog of the desert. Its jaws are huge. It is timid, but once it bites it will not let go.
A spiny puffer fish of Kamino. It swallows water to puff up. Its spines are poisonous.
An IG-100 MagnaGuard. Its pincer arms can crush anything. It was built to guard a general.
A shelled bug of Felucia that brews berry juice. It stores fruit in its shell, where it turns into juice.
A Hoth ice scrabbler. It is cunning and vicious. It hides in the snow to ambush prey.
A gorax cub of Endor. It licks its paws because they are soaked with honey. It is cute and playful.
A giant gorax of Endor's mountains. It sniffs out food in the forest. Ewoks build their villages high to avoid it.
A tauntaun kit of Hoth. It digs in the snow with its nose to find moss. Its fur keeps it warm.
A tauntaun. Smells bad on the outside. Its thick fur and fat keep it warm in Hoth's bitter cold. Rebels ride them.
A squid of Kamino that fires water jets. It can hit flying prey from far below the surface.
An octopus with a water cannon. It holds its prey with its tentacles and fires a jet of ink.
A bird that brings Life Day gifts to Kashyyyk. It carries food in its tail and shares it with the lost.
A manta that glides on stellar winds. It swims through nebulas in flocks. It feeds on gas and starlight.
A dark-cave hound of Lothal. It hunts in packs and cannot stand light. Its howl warns its pack of danger.
A fyrnock pack alpha. The leader of the pack has the darkest hide. Its fiery breath scorches its foes.
A TC-series protocol droid. It can translate any language in the galaxy. It was upgraded to work in space.
An ikopi of Naboo's grass plains. Its curved horns make the air shimmer. Staring at them makes the mind go blank.
A painter creature of Tatooine. It copies any move it sees with its tail. Its marks can be found on canyon walls.
A training droid from Kamino's labs. It fights anyone to grow stronger. Its program decides which fighter it becomes.
A combat droid that spins on its head. It fights by spinning and kicking like a top. Its spin can carve the ground.
A small narglatch cub of Orto Plutonia. It bumps its nose against anything to sense it. It loves the ice and snow.
An IG-RM thug droid. It stores power in its body. It swings its arms to build up a charge.
A small lava creature of Mustafar. It breathes out flames, and smoke rises from it when it is happy or sad.
A plump Naboo shaak. Its milk is full of nutrients. Gungans and Naboo farmers raise them on the grass plains.
A 2-1B surgical droid. It is a kind droid that tends to anyone who is hurt. It fitted Luke's new hand.
A legendary thunder beast of Endor. It came down with lightning. It roars like thunder and runs as fast.
A legendary volcano beast of Mustafar. It is said to have been born in a lava eruption. It burns with rage.
A legendary aurora beast of Naboo. It runs across the water and purifies the lakes. It is said to bring the north wind.
A Zillo beast hatchling of Malastare. It eats soil and grows. Once it has eaten a whole mountain, it sleeps.
A Zillo beast in its armored shell. Its body is made of gas under pressure. It moves by blasting the gas.
The Zillo Beast. Its armor cannot be pierced by any blaster. It once rampaged across Coruscant.
A legendary sea bird of Mortis. Its wings can cause a storm that lasts 40 days. It sleeps at the bottom of the sea.
A legendary sky bird of Mortis. Its feathers glow in seven colors. A rainbow is said to follow it wherever it flies.
A spirit that walks the World Between Worlds. It wanders through time. Forests where it appears are said to bloom.
